title: Air-fryer kale chips
subtitle: Kale leaves dried and crisped in the air fryer to a light, papery chip.
excerpt: Curly kale torn into pieces, tossed in a small amount of oil and seasoning, then air-fried at low heat until completely crisp and light. Ready in 8 minutes. Serves two as a snack.
sourceNotes: Kale chips became widely known in British home cooking around 2010, popularised through food blogs and health food culture. The air fryer produces them in under 10 minutes, faster than an oven method and with more even crisping.

content.text: Kale chips need low heat and a completely dry leaf. Cook at 150°C rather than 200°C: higher temperatures char the thin leaf edges before the thick stem dries out. The kale must be completely dry before oiling or the moisture prevents crisping. Use only a small amount of oil ,  too much makes them soggy rather than crisp.

items.prepNote: curly kale, thick central ribs removed, torn into 5 cm pieces

content.text: Wash the {{kale}} and spin completely dry in a salad spinner. If you don't have a spinner, spread on a clean tea towel and pat dry ,  any remaining moisture will stop the chips crisping. Toss the dry kale with {{olive-oil}} of oil, massaging it in with your hands so every piece is coated. Season with {{sea-salt-fine}} of salt.

Preheat the air fryer to 150°C. Place the kale in the basket ,  it can be loosely layered rather than a single layer as it will shrink. Cook for 4 minutes, shake, and cook for a further 3-4 minutes until the pieces are completely dry, crisp, and papery. Check after 6 minutes: kale goes from crisp to burnt quickly. Remove and cool for 2 minutes before eating ,  they crisp further as they cool.

items.symptom: Chips soft and chewy, not crisp
items.cause: Kale still wet, or too much oil.
items.fix: The kale must be completely dry before oiling. Use the minimum amount of oil ,  enough to just coat each piece, not drench it.

items.symptom: Chips burning at the edges before crisping
items.fix: Cook at 150°C only. Higher temperatures char the thin edges before the thicker pieces dry out.

items.cause: Still slightly moist when removed from the fryer.
items.fix: Leave in the air fryer for an extra minute with the heat off. They should be papery and light, not at all pliable.

content.text: Kale chips are a savoury snack to eat immediately after cooking. They do not keep well once they are crisp ,  even in a sealed container they soften within a few hours. The method works with cavolo nero leaves stripped from the stems in the same way.
